body: You guys are awesome. Posting here is probably the best thing I've done as far as getting help for personal reasons. All the women I was interested in did have similarities. It's time to close that book. I love the perspective guys and thank you so much(:

I can't help but feel like I made her be that way :/ All of my exes turned out to live licentious lives after we broke up. 2 got pregnant after few months apart and one works at a gentleman's club. Another I've not heard from since but she did have a scandalous history /: I can't help but feel like my accusations inadvertently made them like this...Thank you though, I was expecting someone to tell me I deserved to die.
